capture_point: Replacement Android dashboard logging vehicleinterface callbacks, plus passive candump of vcan0 on the head unit
user_report: Rider cycled ride modes with the mode button (short presses and a ~3 s hold), entered reverse twice with the reverse button, and confirmed what the stock HMI calls each mode. Hyper access was disabled in the owner app.

events_observed_in_application_log.note: after the power button in PARK (VehicleStates DRIVE)
emitted when the cycle reaches the Hyper slot; the mode then becomes CUSTOM
short press from SPORT with Hyper revoked
~3 s hold of the mode button; ECU mode LIMPHOME; rider confirmed the stock HMI shows this as Eco
short pulse on the reverse button press
both reverse entries; the stock HMI setting at the time was Easy Park (forward and back at low speed)

raw_frame_changes_on_entering_reverse.note: same values on both reverse entries
candidate mode/state bits; see open question for 0x143
candidate telltale bits; see open question for 0x353

limitations: Sanitized summary; complete logs, identifiers and the VIN are not published.
LIMPHOME = Eco is rider-confirmed against the stock HMI on this scooter and firmware only; the enum name is unchanged in the catalog.
Plain reverse (stock HMI setting other than Easy Park) was not captured; whether it reports DriveModes REVERSE or PARK_ASSIST is unknown.
Raw-frame changes are before/after comparisons over a few seconds, not decoded field layouts; other bytes moved with speed and temperature.
One vehicle, one session; other generations and firmware are not covered.
